headline:
Your music.
Your space.
intro: Less noise. More of what you love. Bring your tracks together, discover a new sound, and stay in your own rhythm.
continue: PICK UP WHERE YOU LEFT OFF
mockNote: Illustrative interface · no audio in this preview
sources: Different sources. One space for your music.
experienceTitle:
Everything you need.
Nothing in the way.
experienceIntro: A player that keeps the focus where it belongs. Find, collect, and control your music your way.
queueText: Playlists, favorites, and a queue that makes sense. Keep your tracks close and your next listen closer.
themeText: Light, dark, rose, violet, or ocean. Choose your palette, with English and Ukrainian interface languages.
backupText: Local profiles, listening history, and backups. Hold onto the collections you want to come back to.
islandVisual:
Small when you listen.
Expanded when you need it.
islandTitle:
A little player.
A lot more space.
islandText: Skip tracks, pause, and adjust the volume from Island. Compact and expanded modes keep playback within reach without returning to the main window.
releaseNote:
Preview build 1.1.1 · Not publisher-signed.
Exit SoundFlow from the system tray before installing.
faq1: Do I need to install it?
answer1: Choose the installer or portable archive. For portable, extract the entire archive and run the SoundFlow.exe launcher at its root.
answer2: Your library and settings are stored locally on your computer. Server sign-in is available separately; signing in does not imply automatic synchronization of your entire library.
answer3: This release is available for Windows x64 only. Other platforms are not currently offered.
